query: SELECT terms.field AS "field!", terms.id AS "id!", terms.source_version_id, CASE WHEN octet_length(terms.name) > $3 THEN NULL WHEN octet_length(to_jsonb(terms.name)::text) > $3 THEN NULL ELSE terms.name END AS name FROM ( SELECT 'genres' AS field, g.id, g.name, j.source_version_id FROM manifestation_genres j JOIN genres g ON g.id = j.genre_id WHERE j.manifestation_id = $1 AND 'genres' = ANY($2) UNION ALL SELECT 'moods', g.id, g.name, j.source_version_id FROM manifestation_moods j JOIN moods g ON g.id = j.mood_id WHERE j.manifestation_id = $1 AND 'moods' = ANY($2) UNION ALL SELECT 'tags', g.id, g.name, j.source_version_id FROM manifestation_tags j JOIN tags g ON g.id = j.tag_id WHERE j.manifestation_id = $1 AND 'tags' = ANY($2) ) terms ORDER BY terms.field, terms.id LIMIT $4
